We need find contradiction between evidence and testimony. Look at testimonies: 0-4.

Testimony 1: "Simon and I were standing in the hallway in front of the dressing room." Person Geiru.

Testimony 4: "I was in the yard, but the door was wide open, so I could keep watch on the dressing room."

Testimony 2: "Before Uendo discovered the body, the only person who had gone in there was Bucky."

Testimony 3: "Come to think of it, a little while before Bucky showed up, Jugemu was barking like mad!" (Jugemu maybe a dog?)

Evidence 1: Backstage Diagram: "The door to the dressing room and the door to the yard face one another. When the door of the yard is open, the door blocks the view from the yard to the dressing room."

Important: When yard door open, it blocks view from yard to dressing room. So if yard door open, you cannot see dressing room from yard.

Testimony 4 says Geiru was in yard, door wide open, could keep watch on dressing room. That contradicts evidence 1 which says open yard door blocks view from yard to dressing room. So contradiction between Evidence 1 and Testimony 4.

Check spatial rules: Rule 4: If XXX is facing YYY and the door between them is open then XXX can see YYY. Not relevant.

Rule 5: If XXX blocks the view from YYY to ZZZ then YYY cannot see ZZZ when XXX is present. Not directly.

But we have rule about door blocking view: Not in list, but we can use rule 5: If XXX blocks the view from YYY to ZZZ then YYY cannot see ZZZ when XXX is present. Here XXX is the yard door, YYY is yard, ZZZ is dressing room. The door blocks view, so YYY (yard) cannot see ZZZ (dressing room) when door is present (open). So rule 5 applies.

Thus contradiction: Evidence says door blocks view, testimony says can watch.

Thus answer: evidence 1, testimony 4.
